text.body: śrīgaṇeśāyanamaḥ|| oṃ asya śrīṝṇamocana mahāgaṇapatistrotra maṃtrasya bhagavān śukrācāryāṝṣiḥ ṝṇamocanagaṇapatirdevatā ṝṇamocanārthe jape viniyogaḥ oṃ smarāmi devadeveśaṃ vakratuṇḍaṃ mahābalaṃ || mahāvidhnaharaṃ saumyaṃ namāmi ṝṇamuktaye ||1|| mahāgaṇapatiṃ devaṃ mahāsatyaṃ mahābalaṃ || mahāvidhnaharaṃ saumyaṃ namāmi ṝṇāmuktaye ||2|| ekākṣaraṃ ekadaṃtaṃ ekabrahmasanātanaṃ || ekamevāravditīyaṃ ca namami ṝṇāmuktaye ||3|| raktāṃbaraṃ raktavarṇaṃ raktaṃgadhānulepanaṃ || raktapuṣpaiḥ pūjāmānaṃ namāmi ṝṇāmuktaye ||4|| kṛṣṇāṃbaraṃ kṛṣṇavarṇaṃ kṛṣṇagaṃdhānulepanaṃ || kṛṣṇapuṣpaiḥ pūjyamānaṃ namāmi ṝṇamuktaye ||5|| pītāṃbaraṃ pītavarṇaṃ pītagaṃdhānulepanaṃ || pītapuṣpaiḥ pūjyamānaṃ namāmi ṝṇamuktaye ||6|| dhūmrāṃbāraṃ dhūmravarṇaṃ dhūmragaṃdhānulepanaṃ || dhūmrapaṣpaiḥ pūjyamānaṃ namāmi ṝṇamuktaye ||7|| sarvāṃbaraṃ sarvavarṇaṃ sarvagaṃdhānulepanaṃ || sarvapuṣpaiḥ pūjyamānaṃ namāmi ṝṇamuktaye ||8|| bhadrajātaṃ ca rupaṃ ca pāśāṃkuśadharaṃ śubhaṃ || sarvavighnaharaṃ devaṃ namāmi ṝṇamuktaye ||9|| yaḥ paṭhet ṝṇaharastotraṃ prātaḥkāle śucirnaraḥ || ṣaṇmāsābhyaṃtare caiva ṝṇacchedo bhaviṣyati ||10|| iti śrībrahmāṃḍapurāṇe ṝṇamocanamahāgaṇapatistotraṃ saṃpūrṇam |
